prompt: In 1908 a fireboat operated by the Chicago Fire Department sank and was later refloated. When was the state that bears the same name as the fireboat founded?
answer: The fireboat was the **Illinois**. The state of Illinois was founded as a state on **December 3, 1818**, when it was admitted to the Union. (The Illinois Territory had been established earlier, in 1809.)
